tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Properties of the limiting path] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0473, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0474 ↗ lem:chow-iii-h54-distance-superlevel ↗ lem:chow-iii-h55-broken-geodesic-bound 1. apph:H.57\group Integral curves

The limiting path satisfies $\Gamma _\infty (f(x))=x$, is Lipschitz, $f(\Gamma _\infty (s))=s$, and \[ \limsup _{\sigma \to 0^+}\frac{d_C(\Gamma _\infty (s+\sigma ),\Gamma _\infty (s))}{\sigma } \le |\nabla f(\Gamma _\infty (s))|^{-1}. \]
